fusions.name: Trampling Spin
fusions.desc: Crashes down on every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 28 damage. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have covered since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Unflagging Lunge
fusions.desc: A snapping strike that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have covered since you last used it (max 25%). Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Staying Power
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Wellspring
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds. Your armour rises by 6%.
